summary: Jared Kushner, Donald Trump's son-in-law, ran his family's real-estate firm and owned The New York Observer before serving as Trump's senior adviser from 2017 to 2021, when he led the First Step Act and the talks behind the 2020 Abraham Accords. He then founded Affinity Partners, funded mostly by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. Since 2025 he has worked informally with envoy Steve Witkoff on Gaza, Ukraine and Iran negotiations, and in January 2026 he was named to the Board of Peace overseeing Gaza.
